description: Declare a follow for a show, or clear a mute. Pass a podcast_id from search_podcasts. A declared follow stays until unfollow_podcast, regardless of fetch activity, and does not use one of the five automatic slots. For a show never fetched, what counts as new starts from its newest episode now. Does not consume credits.

podcast_id.description: Show id (the podcast_id field from a search_podcasts result).

name: follow_podcast
title: Follow a show
